ui.lessonGoal: Express opinions, explain reasons and ask follow-up questions.
ui.levelTip: Choose four or five stations. Give a reason and a real example. Ask your partner at least one follow-up question.

presentation.introduction: AI is already part of our phones, schools, jobs and media. What should we welcome, question or limit? Discuss eight real situations together.
presentation.privacyNotice: Use fictional examples whenever you prefer. Do not share passwords, private messages, photographs or personal information with an AI tool during this lesson.
